_comment: 30 dictation prompts in three tiers. `prompt` is what to say (naturally, fillers welcome); `intended` is the text you'd want to SEND. Edit both to match real usage before recording.

Hey Sarah, thanks for sending the proposal over. The scope looks right but the timeline feels optimistic — the integration work alone usually takes three weeks. Can we add a buffer week before the launch date? Happy to hop on a call tomorrow if that's easier.

Team, quick update on the quarter. Revenue is tracking eight percent ahead of plan, mostly from the annual plan push. The two things I'm watching: support response times crept up past four hours, and trial-to-paid conversion dipped slightly after the pricing change. Let's dig into both at Monday's standup.

Hi Marcus, following up on our conversation at the conference. You mentioned your team is struggling with meeting overload — that's exactly the problem we're working on. Would you be open to a fifteen-minute demo next week? No slides, just the product.

Hey, I reviewed the contract and two things need to change before I can sign. First, the exclusivity clause in section three is too broad — it should only cover the dictation category. Second, payment terms should be net thirty, not net sixty. Otherwise we're good to go.

Thanks for the bug report. I was able to reproduce it — the app loses the custom dictionary after an update if you installed before version two. The fix will be in Thursday's release. As a workaround, you can re-import the dictionary from Settings.

Quick heads up before the board meeting. The deck is in the shared folder. The one number that needs context: the spike in March was the AppSumo promotion, not organic growth, so don't extrapolate from it. Everything else is straightforward.

I've been thinking about the onboarding flow all weekend. The problem isn't the number of steps, it's that we ask for permissions before showing any value. Let's flip it: first dictation works in a sandbox text field, then we ask for accessibility access once they've seen the magic.

Hi Jen, welcome aboard! A few things to get you started. Your laptop should arrive Wednesday. Slack and email invites are already sent. Your first week is mostly meeting the team — I've set up coffee chats with everyone. Don't worry about shipping anything until week two.

The vendor quote came in at twelve thousand for the year, which is double what we budgeted. I pushed back and they offered nine if we commit to two years. My gut says take it — switching costs would eat any savings from shopping around. Your call.

Reflecting on the launch: what went well was the waitlist strategy and the demo video. What didn't was timing the announcement during a holiday week, and we underestimated support volume by half. Next launch we hire a temp for support week one and never ship on a Friday.
Schedule the review for March 3rd at 10:30 with Priya, Nguyen, and the Kubernetes team.
The MRR went from 42k to 58k, that's roughly 38 percent growth quarter over quarter.
Three things: first, fix the appcast URL. Second, bump the CFBundleVersion. Third, re-run the notarization.
Send the DMG to the beta list, but hold the SendFox campaign until Gatekeeper validation passes.
